reviews.title: AAA games should take notes
reviews.text: I am once again floored by the capability of an indie developer. I keep wanting to write an essay about how great it is, but I’ll try to keep this short. Pros -The multi-character system is compelling and surprisingly well balanced. -Maps are places you return to and have secrets to discover. -Bosses have defining features outside of health bars and art style. -Dungeons have their own stats and equipment so new players are equally welcome in raids. -The text and dialogue is entertaining while being suitable for a casual game. The humor is satyrical, self-aware, punny, and peppered with gamer jokes. -NPCs are memorable. -Purchasable upgrades are accessible through regular progress and feel like normal upgrades. -Quality of life features that I wish more developers used (some are earned through quests, but nothing has felt unreasonable) Cons -It’s easy to find a group for the first dungeon

reviews.title: I cannot put this game down
reviews.text: I've been playing Idleon for over a year and a half now.  Although a majority of my time is on the Steam version, I still have the app for those long weekends where I still want to check in on daily claims.  The game starts by benefitting idle play and character management, but as you unlock certain classes snd skills, active play becomes relevant again.  I would only recommend playing this game on your phone as a complementary experience to playing via browser or Steam.  Genuinely fair monetization where paying money feels more like donating to the developer than anything else.

reviews.title: Very generous content, can be convoluted.
reviews.text:
Firstly, I feel like quitting the game because the game crashes whenever I load my first character. There’s so much going on I can’t imagine what’s causing it. Perhaps an option on the character select screen to wipe whatever the characters are currently doing to spawn them back at the beginning as something of a failsafe might be an idea, idk.

The abundance of systems that all feed into each other is good fun, but also gets overwhelming. It’s very easy to get lost in it all and miss vital details. The quests are actually kind of annoying as you have to go back to the quest giver to finish them. It’s wasted time and remembering where everything is is a mental load that’s already borderline too much.

It was still one of the best games on the App Store since there’s no ads and you could play and play. But the game crashing one of my characters really ruins it.

reviews.title: One of the funniest idle games I’ve played
reviews.text:
I’ve been playing this game through Steam for maybe a year now and just love it. I love that there’s so many different ways to boost your characters’ stats: from the statues/stamps in worlds 1, alchemy and post office in world 2 etc. I’ve watched several streams that Lava has done on twitch, and you can tell that the guy genuinely cares about his work, but also the experience of the people that play.

The events game itself has a “pay-to-win” system, so to speak, but it is completely not needed by the average player. Gems, AFK Candies, and rare things like that can be gotten simply by playing the game and require almost no interaction with the store. Which in today’s environment is a breath of fresh air.

Overall there’s a ton to do in the game to keep you entertained, and a lot of satire that’ll have you laughing as you come across them.

reviews.title: Such a large amount of stuff to do!
reviews.text:

I’ve been playing for about a month (Steam version) and there has been no shortage of things to do/improve/increase/level/etc. each world introduces new stuff that can help increase bonuses character and game-wide.
I tuned into LavaFlame2’s (the Dev) stream for this release, and it was quite enjoyable. Lots of little informational tidbits, a bunch of giveaways, and it was cool to see a little inside the mind that made this game.
Lava, if you somehow read this, I love the game you’ve made, so far, and hope you continue to make it even more awesome!

The progression in the game is very balanced but it can be slightly confusing at times. I’ve been playing for a month or two and haven’t hit any hard caps in my progression. I don’t like the fact that you can’t change the name of your characters at all or delete ones with classes you no longer want. The game gets frequent updates by a single lead developer and tbh idk how he does it. He adds funny jokes into the game and entertaining quest lines. The community is also really cool and helpful.

reviews.title: Haven’t been bored despite playing since April 2021
reviews.text:
Played this game on Steam since April 2021, the month it was originally released and have been an active player for about 1.5 years, and have been loving the content.

I haven’t gotten bored of the gameplay and have always something to look forward to in the morning or at night. This is an Idle game so it is time based. It did start off slow in the beginning but trust me, you won’t regret it once you reach your triple digit damage. All the mini goals I’ve set for myself and completed have made this game that much more enjoyable.

A lot of games require a pay 2 win format otherwise the games are hardwalled from continuing in content. BUT NOT HERE, there’s no need to pay but you can! However you can gain gems relatively easily and be able to buy your own upgrades to improve your progress speed.

The community is really helpful if you want to share achievements or ask for help if something

reviews.title: Constant Updates Keep This Game Fresh and Exciting!
reviews.text:
Huge kudos to the developers for their dedication to keeping this game alive and thriving! The frequent updates not only bring new content but also improve gameplay, balance mechanics, and keep things interesting. It’s rare to see a game that actively listens to its player base and continues to evolve in meaningful ways.

Every update adds something fresh, making the game more engaging and fun to play. Whether it’s new features, QoL improvements, or just fixing bugs quickly, it’s clear that the devs truly care about the community.

If you’re looking for a game that doesn’t get stale and keeps you coming back for more, this is it! Amazing work, and I can’t wait to see what’s next! 🎉🔥👏

reviews.title: Updating review: Still enjoying the game very much!
reviews.text: Back to update my review again since Lava’s major updates. Still enjoying the game very much! So many quality of life changes were added and it’s freshen up the game quite a bit. Keep up the great work, Lava! And regarding the recent follower addition, I understand part of the communities’ frustration and criticism. But taking a step back and looking at the big picture, this is mainly a single-player game with multiplayer features. I don’t think it’s wrong for some to progress faster through premium currency as it won’t affect anyone else. Just my 2 cents. Again, keep up the awesome work, Lava and trying to not let the negativity stop you from improving Idleon.

reviews.title: iOS supported game unusable on iOS devices
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a game you can play on your phone or iPad, read on. The game has been unplayable on iOS for nearly 2 months, meaning you must play the game in a browser, which defeats the point of the app.

Even once this is updated, the iOS apps are often delayed releases, with the game immediately playable through Steam or browser, leaving the iOS app nonfunctional. This is complicated by the Dev needing to patch updates constantly, with the latest period of disjunction being par for the course. 

In addition, there are significant bugs that are “normal”in the iOS, including idle gains being nerfed (sometimes by massive amounts) which function fine in the browser and steam apps. This is super unsatisfying when the point of the idle gain genre being….idle play. Just play on steam.

reviews.title: Most unique idle game you’ll ever play
reviews.text: This is easily the best idle game on the market. Smooth progression with actual quest lines, phenomenal music and graphics, lots of good humor and character dialogue, literal months of new content to do without getting stuck in a daily grind fest til you get the one item you need, and best of all is easily free to play. The developer is an awesome guy as well, always listens to the community, does streams on Twitch where he gives away in game items and currency, and is funny to boot. I’ve never played another idle game with as much content as this while constantly being updated for free, this was my favorite idle game prior to it being released on the Apple App Store, and now it’ll be even more so.

reviews.title: IdleOn is mobile for me, finally!
reviews.text: I have played Idleon for the better part of the past 1.5 years on Steam, and I was eagerly awaiting the iOS release!  Now I can play one of my favorite games on the go.  Thank you so much for all the work that inevitably went into making this version possible.  The only issue I’ve had with the app is a technical one: the game is forced to be played in a certain orientation on the phone, but the phone does not recognize that it is in that orientation, making the buttons and presses slightly off (I have to press higher than usual to make things activate).  For what seemed like a silly game at first to me to become so fun and involved, I just want to say thanks a bunch Lava!

reviews.title: Amazing Game (Update)
reviews.text: This is without a doubt one of the best idle games ever made. I’ve enjoyed every moment of play time and when I don’t have time I come back to find loads of rewards when I return. The game is very humorous and I love the quirky npcs to death. The gameplay is pretty simple (as it should be) but with enough depth and optimization options to really let a player decide where to focus their efforts. The crafting system is a blast to use and requires appropriate grinding for resources. I love this game a lot. It really is amazing. There’s a lot to do and I’ll be playing this for a long time. I’m very impressed with the developer. Very prompt response times and very active healthy community. Love it all.

reviews.title: Keeps Crashing During Dungeon Rush
reviews.text: I want to express that I have enjoyed playing so far, the only downside is that my game constantly crashes during the dungeon rush. It is so disappointing to waste 10 min in a dungeon, only for your game to crash and when you open it back up it removes all of your rewards. I have gotten to the third phase, 4 separate times now and had it on it’s last leg and my game crashes. It also happens when I roll for my loot, losing all that progress that I had. A great fix would be for the NPC out side the dungeon to hold the rewards for you if that happens. It is so disappointing because it takes away a dungeon play. I really want to give the game 5 stars, but until this bug is fixed the score will only get lower until the problem is resolved.

reviews.title: Amazing concept, better execution
reviews.text: This game is literally the best game I’ve ever played, insane to think it was made by only 1 person. I’ve recommended this game to all my friends that like min/maxing. The idea of creating multiple characters that can share items is genius for maximizing efficiency in different areas of the game. The skill curve feels natural and isn’t punishing, you can go at your own pace and progress in so many different areas that it never gets stale. It’s hard to get into, but once you grasp the basics you can streamline the process for each subsequent character you create and it feels soooo satisfying to grasp all the different aspects of the game.

reviews.title: If you've ever played an MMO, play this
reviews.text:
Really fun, fills the void left by the MMO market these days. Has the least scummy monetization scheme I've experienced, infinite (or close enough) playability, no scummy "play every day for the next 5 years if you want to win"-- afking is often the best choice (if only for ease), and you can rest easy leaving the game for however long, knowing you're not losing anything. With that said, there's also a lot of stuff you can micromanage if you're that kind of person or if you just have more time you want to spend on a given day. 

Really superb, I've never left a review and this will proudly be my first--idleon easily deserves 5 stars.

reviews.title: A great game and concept ruined by lack of knowledge in player friendly monetization
reviews.text:
The first downturn of this game was adding auto loot, a basically necessary feature that was promised with the pets update, as a dollar only purchase.  This conflicts with most other things in the game that are gem purchases, and gems can be earned in game.  This means that the game was largely kept from being p2w as you could, over time, earn most premium bonuses.

Now, there has been a gatcha element added with none of the gameplay and all of the insane cost.  For just $900 dollars you can have a 9/10 chance to get a singular companion which will make you speed through the game faster than any other person could ever hope to.  There is no way to make these rolls using in game mechanics, aside from the one per week.  

Really disappointing as I liked the game alot.

reviews.title: What a gem!
reviews.text:
Do you like mmorpgs? Collection games? Management sims?  Incremental idlers? If you said yes to any or all of these you should give this game a chance.
  Taking control of and advancing many characters across a variety of class advancement paths and dozens of skills to specialize in.  There is never a lack of things to do.  At the same time you never need feel pressured to log in constantly, you are always progressing something. 
   The developer is excellent, always updating and interacting with the community.  By himself creating a game many times more fun and addictive than most AAA studios.  
  In short, don’t miss out on this one!!

reviews.title: So So Good
reviews.text: I genuinely love this game. The developer imbues so much charisma and character into every aspect. It’s incredibly fun to play. Perfectly low maintenance but still a blast with SO MUCH to do, learn, and explore. Plus, there is still more to come. I am so happy to have stumbled upon this. If you’re even kind of considering just go for it. The in app purchases are entirely optional, the currency can be gained in game just by playing it too. But if you enjoy the game at all I highly suggest throwing whatever you can to the developer because he has absolutely earned it and deserves it. Wish more developers were like him. Thanks Lava!

reviews.title: Badly broken game, developer is garbage
reviews.text: The thing is that this game is often lots of fun. Unfortunately, it’s riddled with bugs and poor planning. At one point (very recently) he made his own game inaccessible for over a month for people playing on iOS. This he blamed on iOS, but iOS players are regularly locked out of the game due to an unwillingness to clear it with iOS ahead of release. The developer reads his support emails once a week and often replies, but if the issue is complex enough, the issue is never fixed, and he simply stops replying. There are so many confounding bugs in the game right now. A quick perusal of its sub-Reddit tells the story, but the developer also regularly deletes posts pointing out his shortcomings. All this, and the game becomes more and more expensive every day.

The launch version of this game is very impressive and to be cross-platform and all developed by one person is amazing. I would definitely like to see more multiplayer aspects implemented soon but the dungeons are already great but I’d like to see more things to do with friends and an update on the guilds. Can’t wait to see what lava has in store for us next.

reviews.text: I like the overall gameplay experience it’s pretty fun. But the mini game mechanics need some work, because when I was playing the animal sorting mini game for XP. My player was still moving around and got killed by the mutant slime monster in the forest. And when you use a item as a new slot it doesn’t make a notification pop up saying that you can’t equip because you need to be the correct level, but it’s still a overall good game I love it and hope to see this game become better and more popular in the future.

reviews.title: Great concept and Satisfying Progression
reviews.text: I love the design and utilization of multiple characters. This game does require a lot of micro management, but you can really go at your own pace and always see results. Even “true endgame” has plenty to do while seeing those numbers climb in a satisfying way. All, of the in-game purchases are mostly QOL. Yes, a few might speed things up, but you can still reach EVERY goal without spending a penny. Gems are also easy to get. So you can buy everything in the shop eventually without $$$. Great game. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: **Too addictive**
reviews.text: This game has had a grip on me like none other. As a person with ADHD I constantly lose interest in games because of the boring or long play times. This game is perfect because it allows me to really be awarded for living my life. I am always checking the game in those random spots in my day where you are longing for a quick game fix on your phone. Something to change up the banter of everyday life. You are awarded by not playing with giving you AFK gains! It’s like you’re basically playing 24/7! I couldn’t recommend this game more!

reviews.title: Really fun game, but the FOMO and timegates are too much
reviews.text:
This game is fun, really fun, but the addition of jewels/chips and the pet system ruins the game by a lot. Having to wait 8 MONTHS in between some Jewel/chip rotations like Chocolatey Chip is much too long, and makes you not want to play anymore. You can buy chips in the shop for gems, at a 1/22 chance of getting it for 385 gems each, which isn’t easy to come by at all, especially with the developer heavily nerfing the methods to get gems everytime one is discovered. It would make the game so much better if you could at least reroll the jewel/chip shop. 
Not to mention the pet system where the odds are so astronomically low for such an important pet with such extremely powerful bonuses.

reviews.title: 5 years and still enjoying
reviews.text: Been playing the game for 5 years now. Started playing the game with my young son at his request back when the game just came out. My boy played idle skilling and and we came over to try this one out together. There is always something new coming out in an update which keeps the grind very interesting. So many features. And the discord channel always has give aways and very active community. Great game. Very fun!! Love the events at holiday time and of course anniversary time. Cheers LavaFlame2 keep up the good work.

reviews.title: Fun, but
reviews.text:
This game is fun, but I play it knowing full well the developer weighs rewards to favor 
long term players over newbs. For example, holiday rewards that can only be gotten by reaching a certain world. If you haven’t played long enough, you can’t get the rewards. Additionally, if you play IOS, you will get the updates a day late, but rather than staggering the release date, the developer lets other platforms get a head start on IOS users. Again, the game is fun, but I know I will always be behind and denied rewards for not having played as long as others.

reviews.title: Best and only one of its kind
reviews.text: I’ve played this game for as long it was out and it’s the best idle game in the world. There’s no game like this as it’s the only game to be MMO style but also be an idle game all in one. The game never feels like it is required to pay to play the game. When grinding materials and what not, you don’t need to do it actively. Also the first ever game to introduce multiple intertwined characters to play, allowing you to experience every class and sub class and grind multiple things at once. Glad to see this game go on iOS, best game on the store.

reviews.title: Crashing Issues + Bugs + Potential Scandals?
reviews.text: First off: its an okay-ish mmorpg on its own. Its a bit linear and most of the quests are just “kill 100 of this thing” most of the time as-well the game does not know what it wants to be. There is so much out of place stuff and its plain odd. There are also some alleged stuff about this game having scandals, but i will have to do more research to find it out. There are many alleged accusations against the dev banning anyone who has constructive criticism of the game. From the sheer amount of people saying these things they could most likely be true. The game gets repetitive and grindy after a week or so of playing. It also crashes quite frequently and i played this on a decent phone. TLDR you might wanna avoid this one.

reviews.title: Had this game on my “to try list”…
reviews.text:
Why didn’t I start earlier?? I love the writing and the art style! I’ve been playing for hours straight - not idling- and I’ve enjoyed every minute of it!! I love the cross character progression for a lot of things and the cute tutorial! It felt a bit overwhelming at first but it takes every new tutorial one step at a time which is very kind. It also offers many related tip videos which are AWESOME! I just needed something new in my life and the humor has helped me breathe a bit of sunshine into the depression I’ve been dealing with day to day. 

 I also do not mind the cash shop one bit and find it very fair so that the creator of the game can get compensation for their hard work! I can’t wait to play this game for many days, weeks, months and years to come!!!

By the way, slime pet is best pet! (Sooo cute!)

Thank you for this amazing game!!!

reviews.title: 9/10 - room for improvement but still amazing
reviews.text:
This game is fantastic. I love the pixel style and all of the options for how to play and what to do. I’d love to see some of the clothing be visible on characters but I also know that this is a solo-dev game and that’s a crapload of work. This game is amazing, and if you’re reading this review then you should just get it and try it out for yourself. Amazingly balanced, love the grind, and still gives ease of idle
play while AFK. Well done, I’ll be buying something from the store just to support this dev.

reviews.title: Good game
reviews.text: I’ve been playing this game for over 2 years now and I can confidently say it’s got all of the good stuff. Do you like killing monsters? Chopping trees? Being a yugioh master? Or maybe feeding and changing the diapers of incompetent npcs? Well idleon has most of that and so much more. The best part of idleon is as long as you’re doing something you will be making progress and by doing something I don’t even mean actively. I’m sitting at 9 characters all farming materials or pushing zones while I’m afk. Perfect game for someone with a chronic case of adhd brain.

The fact that even when I’m not playing I’m still gaining is the win for me! Highly recommend. It has some pay to win aspects but all they seem to do is just speed things up. So it’s no even necessary to buy thing, but the developers is awesome and deserves some support by grabbing a pack or 2. The dev is so very active in supporting this community!

reviews.title: Thank you Lava

reviews.title: Better than I expected, really fleshed out
reviews.text:
I downloaded this game mainly because a youtuber i like promoted it since he’s friends with the dev. I was thinking, alright i’ll give it a shot, i’ll probably delete soon since these idle games always require you to spend money to do well.

not the case! Lava, the singular dev for the game, is really passionate about the game in ways that you can tell, whether it’s from random NPC dialogue, fleshed out quests, fun mechanics that are pretty unique to this game like the minigames, or unique hidden things that he reveals on his twitch stream as he plays and develops the game in front of us

i’d just say, give it a shot.

i personally have spent like $15 over the course of 3 months playing and none of it was necessary, but i feel fine doing it knowing i’m supporting a great, singular developer who isn’t doing this for a cash grab.

This was an excellent game that you could spend some $ on here and there to progress faster, but now the mask is fully off and the best account wide bonuses are locked behind a paywall. This game was an easy 5/5 rating until greed got the best of the developer. Just to add insult to injury he’ll ban you if you are even slightly critical of him in any way.

The game isn’t completely idle. You can ACTIVELY do a TON of stuff like boss fights and idle resources. The best aspect is that there are no time limits to afk and it counts even if the game isn’t open. You can idle from a few hours to a few months and there’s no stopping the afk gains

reviews.title: P2W Despite Description

You have to pay $5 just to get a bundle that makes it so the game doesn’t crash when there’s too many items on the ground…. In an “idle” game… yeah, this game is a joke. I wonder if I can chargeback all the money I’ve spent and say it was stolen…

reviews.text: Idleon has had me hooked since day 1. Progressing is so fun and each world has such an exciting theme. I love grinding games like osrs so Idleon is straight up my alley. Only issue is with the most recent update my game black screens every time I go to log in. I also linked my account with my Apple ID so I wish I could login on my pc when bugs like this occur to progress my account still. Other than those two issues I love the game!

reviews.title: Great game
reviews.text: This game is a lot of fun and I love playing with my husband when I am at work and now that it’s on IOS I am so excited!! The only issue I am having is I can’t buy the $4.99 auto loot package and I thought if I bought the $4.99 gem package it would give the auto loot package since it doesn’t do anything when I click on the banner promoting the auto loot feature but it doesn’t and that’s really all I wanted.

reviews.title: Well Done
reviews.text: I don’t have time to live that MMO life anymore and Idleon gives me everything I need. Smiles, an intense wiki to study, and a distraction from the stresses of real life. As long as you approach the game from a relaxed perspective, you’ll have a blast. I mostly play on browser, but it’s nice to be able to log in for a few minutes when I am at work or on the road. App works great.

reviews.title: quick suggestion
reviews.text: hello. I’m just wondering if you could make it so you don’t have to claim the rewards when rejoining the game after being idle. I’d recommend putting a button near the top of the screen saying *claim idle rewards* and once you quick it. It tells the items you got and gives you it. Great game by the way.

reviews.title: Great but my game is crashing
reviews.text: I’ve been playing pretty actively for the past month or so, but lately every time I try to play. The afk rewards don’t pop up so I don’t get anything. Then when I click anywhere to turn off auto, to go to a portal. The game just crashes. And I’ve already logged out then back in and it’s still happening. Do you have any idea how to fix it?

reviews.title: Fun and progressive
reviews.text: A truly fun game. Has a lot of systems that are introduced at the right speed, lots of knobs to tweak. An original idea where you play many characters to work together and help each other out as many would do in a MMO. And the idea works well. The developer is active on Twitch and Discord. Lots of progressive content, quests and worlds to discover. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: THIS GAME IS AWESOME but…
reviews.text: So this is my favorite game. It’s awesome, and it’s made by an indie game dev who deserves more attention. Great work lavaflame! But this is one issue. Don’t know if it’s just me, but on IOS, some character dialogue crashes the game if it appears on screen. It’s been pretty small except for enraged snakenhotep. But I just got to world four and I get stuck in an endless loop of my game crashing. Please help

reviews.title: Great game and getting better
reviews.text:
This is the first idle game I have ever played and I definitely recommend it. Takes up very little time and always has some goal to reach next.

Developer is pretty active and you can even catch him on stream. Seems to take in community feedback when making improvements to the game.

Try it out!

reviews.title: 10/10 Game
reviews.text: I started playing this game over a year ago, and still play it everyday. As an idle game, it doesn’t require much time, unless of course you want it to. The developer is also amazing. He regularly posts on his discord about new updates and whatnot, and he streams on twitch for most of the updates. I seriously insist you try this game, it’s literally free!

reviews.title: Premium Currency
reviews.text: You used to get so much of it and now the distribution is so unbelievably off. I used to have enough for many things in the gem shop and not anymore. Also please add a better way to get pets, 1 week is a very long time to wait and the green gems for pets is super overpriced and not worth it. Other than those issues, not much wrong with the game.

reviews.title: Great cross-plat Idle MMO
reviews.text: Idleon is a phenomenal Idle/incremental RPG. The core mechanic of building up a roster of specialized characters whose resources all feed into each other’s progression is excellent and keeps me coming back. There is plenty of content already with more always coming. If you’re looking for a game you’ll be playing for months to years, I highly recommend checking this one out.

reviews.title: Best idle game on the market
reviews.text:
I have over 1,000 hour in this game between PC and iOS and I love it. The game respects your time, allowing you to idle as much or as little as you prefer. There are tons of quests, enemies, items, dungeons, secrets and more to keep you busy. 

The game is very playable F2P with some nice quality of life upgrades you can opt into to support the dev if you see fit

reviews.title: Great idea desperately needs more customization
reviews.text: They took all the worst parts of maplestory and fixed them but left out the best parts. There is only one type of character you can be a “stick” no face changing no hair color you cant even change your armor l. The whole point of these mmos is to get strong and feel proud of your accomplishments and individuality but the only way you can show that is with your hat… I get that it was made by one person but even though the idea is amazing I have no drive to play if I just look like everyone else.

reviews.title: Gem Shop issue
reviews.text:
Hello!

Amazing game! Really been enjoying it during my free time! My only issue that recently popped up has been the gem shop… i want to purchase the event Deathbringer Package but its glitched out and wont let me. Hopefully you could fix this issue if anyone else is having too. Keep up the great work huge fan of the game!!!

reviews.title: Phenomenal Game
reviews.text:
This is an incredibly well-designed game. I’m very hooked and excited to keep playing but it does have a lot of bugs. Some of which hinder progress in the game.

Also, there needs to be an option to sign on with Apple ID on the browser version of the game. I didn’t realize I would be locked out of playing on other platforms by using Apple ID and now I feel stuck with an account I’ve spent time and money on.

reviews.title: Update issues
reviews.text: Only one developer so I understand getting help with issues may take time but I have had almost 0 help with issues I have in the game.. I am unable to get invites to party dungeons since the update so I’m losing out on the weekly benefits of that, lost 36 hours of play with 0 xp on most of my characters except 3. I love this game and have spent money on it, and I really wouldn’t mind to spend more but when I get 0 support with any issues I have I no longer feel valued as a gamer.

reviews.title: This game is great but has a problem lately
reviews.text: I have loved playing this game but I have been facing an issue with the characters I haven’t been able to access them and get booted from the app each time I try if you guys could make sure this isn’t happening to anybody else that would be great

reviews.title: Say goodbye to your social life
reviews.text: This game has sucked months out of my life and I’ve only gotten to world 3. One of the most addictive and exciting games to play I’ve ever played. Every morning I look forward to seeing what kind of loot my characters got from idle killing and smiling all night. 10/10 would recommend to all friends.

reviews.title: Amazing new update
reviews.text: I don’t usually post reviews but this game deserves it. This game is very intricate, engaging, and the small references to memes are very funny. The recent QoL improvements have made the game even more enjoyable (which I don’t know how that’s even possible when the game was already amazing!) I love the new corgi hat, I’m saving up for it! Only 50 gems to go! ☺️

reviews.title: Hands down the best idle game I have ever played
reviews.text: This game is wonderful. The developer (singular) is taking so much time and care to make this game a quality game. You don’t have to worry about crazy micro transactions. Unlike a lot of idle games, which start out fun and then kind of get stale after a week, this game has so so much content that stays engaging.

reviews.title: Used to be good
reviews.text:
Dev doesn’t want to do the minimal work it takes to make sure the iOS version is current. It ends up behind all other platforms and you can’t play it if it is.

Dude has also moved massively to pay-to-win. Super depressing. I downloaded this game when I started my chemo treatments a while ago and it really helped me get through tough times in the chair. But to spend a bunch of money on it only to be locked out of playing because he can’t get his stuff together is just rough. Will re-review if things change.

reviews.title: Most complex and enjoyable “idle” game
reviews.text: This is by far a game changer when it comes to idle game styles. It is idle to a point. You could play for hours doing just the daily challenges and going through all the different stuff there is to do every time you log in. You can min/max to your hearts content or just play casually.

reviews.title: Great Game
reviews.text: I have been playing this game close to a year now and it’s quite enjoyable. There is a lot to do in the game, along with a pretty great community. There are a large plethora of guilds to fit most play styles, along with some great and helpful players. The dev is also pretty transparent, and works with the community on fixing bugs and improving the game!

reviews.title: Best game I’ve probably played but 1 big bug
reviews.text: Love this game, concept perfect but recently every time I get to the world for hub or talk to an npc the game crashes I’m not sure if it’s just a problem with my device or if these even get read but I would appreciate if someone could fix it thx (ps keep up the good work)

reviews.title: Fantastic game! Must play!
reviews.text: This is the most fun I’ve ever had in an idle game. You can actively play one while the others are still working for you offline! What a great concept! I love being able to switch from PC to my phone or my iPad! Thanks for making this game! Can’t wait to see where it goes from here!

reviews.title: Very much yes
reviews.text:
I have waited to play this game on iPhone for a whole year just waiting, and now that it’s out I can see how amazing it truly it is, fun game play, amazing mechanics, some funny moments, quality must just top of the line stuff, and a great time killer, so thank you lava for finally being able to release it to iPhone.

Sincerely, A fan

reviews.title: Great afk game
reviews.text: I’ve been playing this for over a year now and it’s the most fun I’ve had on an idle game, even when you don’t want to just afk there’s a good amount of things you can do daily, most idle games I’ve played I’ve reached a p2p ceiling but even with micro transactions in the game you can enjoy the game without spending money

reviews.title: Worth playing.
reviews.text: This game has such depth that there is plenty of content for any real grinder to keep busy for quite a long time. Ive barely scratched the surface of this game and ive been playing here and there for several weeks now. I can definitely see myself playing for a long time.

reviews.title: Honest and fun game
reviews.text: My favorite idle mobile game by FAR. Numbers go up, tinker as much as you like and still make progress. Fantastic dev, incredible customer service, and a real value as far as mobile game spending goes as well. I don’t feel pressured to spend but I do feel rewarded. A true gem of the industry.

reviews.title: It’s fun but restive
reviews.text: After spending over $340 on the game I see one issue that keeps bothering me. Why can’t I change my class? I have no problem paying for the option but why can’t something so simple be implemented? I don’t care if the character starts from “0” I can level the character no problem. I enjoy the game and the effort put on it. Just wish to have simple things fixed.

reviews.title: Best Idle Game Ever!!!!!!
reviews.text: This has been my favorite ultimate idle game ever. My only criticism has always been just that I have to get on my PC to play and don’t have a way to play it on the go. problem solved with this release five stars across-the-board. my favorite aspect of this game is that you can idol for as long as you want to no matter what no limitation.

reviews.title: The best idle game out there
reviews.text: Idleon is a super fun game does need some work for multiplayer though. It could use party mini games and party combat. I also think archer could use a buff. My friend really loves the game and he wants a secret sub class to mage. Like a necromancer or a summoner that would be appreciated. Anyway it’s a great game and it’s super fun that’s why I give 5 stars

reviews.title: Really fun and unique
reviews.text: This is a great game, lots of content and great humor. One of the best and most unique idle and RPG games I’ve played. Having multiple characters you can switch between all contributing to advancing your account together is a fun concept. It also supports the ability to play across multiple devices.

reviews.title: Love this game, but game crashes on one of my characters
reviews.text: I started playing this game a few months ago on iOS, and I love it. The only problem that I’ve had with this game is that for the past 10 days every time I try to play my wind walker the game crashes, but there aren’t any problems with any of my other characters.

reviews.title: Love the game
reviews.text: I’ve been playing this game for years. Is not stressful and just play when I have time. The developer Lava is very creative and the micro transactions are not needed to advance in the game. There are in-game currency called Gems, you can get them in-game fairly easy to buy upgrades or purchase them.

reviews.title: Unique
reviews.text: I will likely be updating this later on after more progress in the game. So far this has been completely different from any other game I have played, idle, or mmo. I am excited to discover more of the game as I progress. Definitely a game I expect to play long term, thanks for making it :)

reviews.title: Most Active Idle Game Ever
reviews.text: This is the most I’ve ever actively played an Idle game. There’s so much to do if you want to grind things actively, but also are never limited to the number of things you can idle grind. So many different systems to play with and level. Lots of number go up, 10/10 recommend.

reviews.title: IdleOn (my wayward son)
reviews.text: Don’t let the simplified character designs let you think the game has no depth or is just another 2D MMO clone. There’s plenty of customization and seemingly endless layers of progress that all interact with one another in satisfying ways. And, mercifully, you can manage it all by yourself if you want.

reviews.title: Great game but..

reviews.title: Game worsens after w1
reviews.text: It can be incredibly fun to play in world 1, but in w2 and 3 it gets pay to win, boring, and repetitive. I really hope this changes for world 4+

reviews.title: Fantastic Game
reviews.text: As someone who grew up playing Maplestory but no longer have the time to play an active MMORPG, this game is absolutely perfect! It has all the aspects a player would love in a MMORPG but is one of the best games at implementing the AFK mechanic simultaneously. Would recommend to anyone who loves idle games but can’t find an idle game that has lasting content.

reviews.title: Good game but many glitches/flaws
reviews.text:
I’ve wanted to delete this game many times but I haven’t and probably will continue to play. A ton of content but very repetitive for the first few weeks, then picks up to become slow and repetitive again. There is a ton of content and I’m roughly half way through so I’d imagine the cycle will continue.

Fun…until you login after several days to find no progress in anything. 
Leave on fighting, game knows you’ve been gone according to the clock but all fields blank. 
Load in and you’ll find poison at max level does true damage per second for only 5 of 10 seconds, along with other flaws. 
Not all the time but happens enough I’ve broke a tv…my phone ricocheted off the wall. 
Hey Lava, you ever going to make this game playable on Apple again?

reviews.title: Great Idle game with so much to do!
reviews.text: I absolutely love this game. The character choices and unique abilities are endless! Only issue I have at the moment is that the game says I need to update it to continue playing, but no update option has showed up at the App Store in IOS for the new world 5 build.

reviews.title: Bugs for Mobile

The game crashes from npc dialogue and gem adds, because of this I can no longer go into the main town because my game crashes. Although there are these bugs the game is great, I just hope the devs can fix it.(^-^)

reviews.title: Perfect Grinding, semi-idle game out there!
reviews.text: I love games that are a grind, that I can play for a long time. I’ve played for a few days now, but I’m hooked. I can tell this game is different from others on the App Store and I’m very excited to continue progressing. There is so much packed into this game and I have only touched the surface!!!

reviews.title: Been playing on Steam
reviews.text: I’ve been playing on steam since the release and the dev is constantly updating the game and adding new features for us. Love this game especially since now I will not have to come home to play; I’ll be able to check in and reset my furnaces on the goooo wooohoo

reviews.title: A game that requires idling
reviews.text: So technically most Idle games you get better faster if you are active. In idleon you can only possibly be on 1 of your 10 characters at a time. The game lets you set each character doing what you want them to do while you play the one you want. Amazing game!

reviews.title: Game is amazing
reviews.text:
This is one of those hidden gem games that will have you completely hooked once you check it out. It has no ads and a very fair f2p model.

Don’t let the cartoony graphics deceive you, the gameplay is incredibly deep and there’s always more to do. The developer updates frequently (free stuff!) and reduces the difficulty of the previous content so new players can catch up. There’s never been a better time to try it out!

I’ve played for almost 4k hours and streamed the game for over 500 hours with no plans to slow down.

You should try it.

reviews.title: Phenomenal game
reviews.text: Been playing on PC for about a year now, and it’s one of my favorite games. Stoked to see it on IOS. If you’re looking for a fun idle game with multiple complex layers of mechanics, while not forcing you to spend money, and play nonstop. Then I would highly recommend you check this out.

reviews.title: Best Idle Game Ever
